title: The non-vanishing locus of a function on a scheme is open
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $U\subseteq X$ open and $g\in\mathcal O_X(U)$. For $x\in U$ write $g_x\in\mathcal O_{X,x}$ for the germ and $g(x)$ for its image in the residue field $\kappa(x)=\mathcal O_{X,x}/\mathfrak m_x$ [def-weil-residue-field]. Put $D(g)=\{x\in U:\ g_x\notin\mathfrak m_x\}$. Then (a) for $x\in U$: $x\in D(g)$ iff $g_x$ is a unit of the local ring $\mathcal O_{X,x}$ iff $g(x)\neq0$ in $\kappa(x)$; (b) $D(g)$ is open in $X$ and contained in $U$; (c) the restriction $g|_{D(g)}$ is a unit of $\mathcal O_X(D(g))$.
